thread:
annie: Follow-up from the shard-3 postmortem: recurring OOMs tied to KV slab fragmentation + growing ephemeral object set. Capturing owners, immediate mitigations, and medium-term actions. Please claim items.

cole: I'll take profiler traces and allocation hotspots. Running `./tools/kv-prof --shard=shard-3 --sample=2s --out=/tmp/trace.json`.

min: I'll own GC/allocator tuning. Short-term idea: bump `slab_compact_threshold` to 0.55 and enable aggressive background compaction in off-peak window.

devops-bot: [alert-bot] OOM alert history: shard-3 triggered OOMs 2026-03-18, 2026-03-20, 2026-03-22. Peak residency before mitigations: 0.81.

annie: Immediate mitigations (target: within 6 hours):
  - min: enable background compaction on shard-3 (non-peak)
  - cole: upload flamegraphs and high-level allocation attribution (link)
  - raj: deploy temporary softlimit=0.6 variant `kv.safe-shard3` and route 100% if needed

cole: Uploaded traces: https://internal/fg/23340 and https://internal/fg/23341. Findings: persistent allocations from `prefix_cache::store_entry` and `metadata::attr->clone`. Allocation rate ~85k/min.

min: Enabled background compaction at 23:30 UTC. Observed slab compaction reducing free-frag by ~12% after first run. Will monitor.

raj: Deployed `kv.safe-shard3` to canary (5%). Canary checks: p99 latency regressions and request error rate. Auto-revert if p95 latency +15% or errors >1%.

devops-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary passed 45m. No regressions. Ready for broader rollout if team approves.

annie: Medium-term deliverables & owners:
  - cole: add `malloc_site` histogram export + nightly heap-scan automation (due 2026-03-29)
  - min: implement adaptive compaction heuristics (based on residency slope) + tests (due 2026-04-05)
  - raj: add runbook snippet for emergency softlimit switch + rollback commands (due 2026-03-26)
  - ops: schedule 3-weekly retrospective for recurring leak pattern analysis (annie)

cole: Question: should we trim prefix_cache entries by count or by size? My vote: size-based trimming with a safety floor to avoid thrashing.

min: Agree on size-based trimming. Also proposing a pre-warm eviction window: run a lightweight trim when residency crosses 0.6 for >2m.

raj: I'll add metrics: `kv.prefix_cache.size_bytes`, `kv.slabs.free_frag_pct`, and alert when free_frag_pct >25% and residency >0.7.

annie: Also scheduling a non-peak heap-scan cron for shard-3 nightly for the next 21 days to surface slow-growth leaks. Will post results weekly.

devops-bot: [incident-bot] OOM resolved after compaction and canary rollout (2026-03-22T23:58:02Z). Memory before=60GB, after=19GB.

cole: Opening PR for telemetry + flamegraph CI.

min: I'll prototype adaptive compaction in a feature branch and add unit tests around slab allocator invariants.

annie: Thanks team. Update this thread as tasks progress. We'll close when all PRs merged and shard residency stable for 14 days.
